name: qbtcp-relay-backend-2
description: QBTCP Internet relay: a tournament-owned Cloudflare Worker and SQLite Durable Object that durably receives scorer traffic while Director is away

RELAY_SETUP_TOKEN.description: Paste the one-time setup token generated by QBBridge. QBBridge exchanges it once when it claims the relay.

RELAY_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Browser origins allowed to use the relay. Use `https://qbsheet.com` unless scorekeepers open QBSheet from another origin; separate multiple origins with commas.
